categories.main_business_segments: The Company operates primarily in two segments: coal mining machinery and auto parts manufacturing. The coal mining machinery segment focuses on integrated coal mining equipment, intelligent control systems, and hydraulic supports. The auto parts segment includes two brands, SEG and ASIMCO, providing automobile starter motors, generators, engine parts, and new energy vehicle components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Company emphasizes intelligent control systems, hydraulic support technology with the highest global standards, and integrated mining equipment. It employs advanced manufacturing processes, digital transformation including SAP systems, AI applications, and smart factory operations. The auto parts segment leverages high-end R&D in energy conservation, emission reduction, and electrification technologies for new energy vehicles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major coal industry groups in China and international markets such as Indonesia, Turkey, Kazakhstan, and others. The auto parts segment serves global automobile manufacturers, focusing on passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and new energy vehicles. The Company also targets emerging markets and aftermarket services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Company operates mainly in the People's Republic of China with significant international presence in Germany, the United States, Canada, Australia, Brazil, Spain, India, Mexico, South Africa, Korea, Thailand, Luxembourg, and other countries. It has subsidiaries and sales networks across these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, manufacturing complete sets of coal mining machinery and automotive parts. It also provides integrated solutions, after-sales services, and digital industrial solutions, positioning itself as a comprehensive equipment supplier and service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, AI integration, electrification, and green sustainable technologies. The Company focuses on R&D for intelligent mining robots, smart mining systems, new energy vehicle components, and industrial intelligence solutions. It aims to become a global leader in intelligent industrial solutions by 2030.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of coal mining machinery and auto parts, including complete equipment sets, hydraulic supports, and automotive components. Additional income comes from trading steel and raw materials, after-sales services, and investment income. The Company also pursues digital transformation and smart factory turnkey solutions as emerging revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Company is a leading manufacturer in the PRC coal mining machinery market and a significant player in the global auto parts market, particularly in new energy vehicle components. It maintains competitive advantages through technological innovation, digital transformation, and global market expansion. Major competitors are not explicitly named but the Company emphasizes its leadership and differentiation in intelligent and integrated solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the Group achieved revenue of RMB 37.05 billion, a 1.73% increase year-on-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.94 billion, up 19.45%. The coal mining machinery segment contributed RMB 19.47 billion in revenue, while auto parts contributed RMB 17.58 billion. The Company has a strong asset base of approximately RMB 49 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and digital transformation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Company offers highly reliable, intelligent, green, and integrated coal mining equipment with leading hydraulic support technology and intelligent mining systems. In the auto parts sector, it provides advanced energy-saving and emission-reducing components, with world-leading technology in 48V hybrid motors and new energy vehicle electric drive systems. Its digital and AI-driven manufacturing and service platforms create differentiated customer value through enhanced efficiency, safety, and sustainability.
